name: load-user-config
body: Load user config: read kalide's per-user settings file into a key-to-value map over the recognised keys; resolve one key; write a recognised key (creating the file and its parent directory); unset a recognised key; list the set recognised keys. `get`/`set`/`unset` operate on recognised keys only — the recognised key set is `default-template-dir`, and a key outside it is a usage error. On `set` of `default-template-dir` it normalises the value to an absolute path (`~` to the user's home directory, a relative path against the current working directory). Local filesystem only, no network. Realised by solution.component.user-config-store and solution.component.config-command.
